name: BusyBoard API
description:
REST API for programmatic access to BusyBoard availability data.
The API exposes cross-person busy/free data while keeping event details private.

Keyless alternative: any BusyBoard share link (`/a/{slug}/{token}`) serves the
same structured availability JSON when requested with
`Accept: application/json` — or with `?format=json` appended for clients that
can't set headers. The token in the URL is the credential; see
`/.well-known/busyboard.json` for details.
